discussion.body: Temple of Light. Seat: far south, Tierso isthmus / open cape. World aspect: day-cycle, sworn oath, navigation, the last beacon that does not lie. Maps stay true while Light holds. Court oaths in Iunum and Gate vows in Breskshire both lean on this without admitting it. Sigil: Meridian. Combat: reveal, break illusion, day-cut against Mist and Nyxara. Civic: ships and rails keep heading. Failure: vows drift, maps lie, final approach to the Fissure is flown by feel. Relation: Light names what Mist hides and what Fire pretends to be. Party link: Maera. Romance beat after Act 7 can sit on a Light-scarred horizon because both leads are required to live.
